title: Resources library
bodyHtml:
Resources library

Publish wiki-style resources for speakers (draft → publish → portal Library).

Where resources live

Open Admin → Resources. Create a page, edit content, publish when ready. Speakers see published pages under the portal Library tab.

Demo seed

Dogfood may include starter seed resources for judges. Prefer publishing at least one resource before a walkthrough so the portal Library is not empty.

Where this lives in the app

  • /admin/resources
  • /portal

Open these routes on your demo or local host while you follow the steps above.
